verdicts.reason: The two layouts are the same except for the headline break. A splits it as 'Chase the / Light', which splits the gold phrase across two lines and leaves 'Light' alone on its own line. B breaks it as 'Chase / the Light', which keeps the white/gold colour split clean. Both share the same flaws: the 'NEW FLAVOR' badge has shrunk to a tiny pill that can't be read and sits below the CTA instead of leading, the oversized CTA overlaps the decorative circles and nearly matches the headline's weight, and the small logo floats with uneven top spacing.
